suppress.notes: CVE-2025-15104 targets validator.nu (Nu Html Checker, github.com/validator/validator) — an HTML validation service by Henri Sivonen. Dependency-Check matches on the substring "validator" in the CPE and misattributes it to org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator, which is the Jakarta Bean Validation reference implementation (unrelated project, no HTML fetching, no SSRF surface).
